title: orion init: show an agent-autonomy notice and ask to continue, with --yes to skip
summary: orion init prints what orion's agents do on their own and asks to continue; --yes skips the question; with no terminal and no --yes it refuses (exit 1) before writing anything and tells an assistant to show the notice first. Every caller passes --yes; README and guide install text updated; help prints the whole header. Version 32.
lessons_learned: A change to a command's interactive behaviour must update its documented install routes (README, guide) in the same PR; the first review caught the assistant-run route refusing.
